summary: São Paulo, Brazil, software engineer, startup founder, experience in product management and front-end development, strong interest in open-source software, advocates for user privacy and digital rights, engaged in discussions about technology and social issues, active in online tech communities (Hacker News, GitHub), emphasizes the importance of user experience and design in technology, believes in the value of diverse perspectives in tech, has a background in psychology and textile technology, interested in the intersection of technology and social impact, supports the idea of transparency in tech and government, critical of traditional corporate structures and practices, values collaboration and community in tech development.
